mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(T.CODE_NO) AS REPORT_TYPE_NO, NVL(GET_GLOBAL_NAME(T.CODE_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), ' ') AS TYPE_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(C.REPORT_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS REPORT_NAME, C.URL_JSP, C.ORDERNO FROM (SELECT ROWNUM AS RN, H.CODE_NO FROM (SELECT S.CODE_NO FROM SY_CODE S WHERE S.ACTIVITY = 1 START WITH S.PARENT_CODE_NO = #{parentCodeNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} CONNECT BY PRIOR S.CODE_NO = S.PARENT_CODE_NO ORDER SIBLINGS BY S.ORDERNO) H) T JOIN REPORT_CENTER C ON TO_CHAR(C.REPORT_TYPE_NO) = TO_CHAR(T.CODE_NO) WHERE C.ACTIVITY = '1' AND C.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY T.RN, C.ORDERNO
